mapper.select: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.avatar, SUM(CASE WHEN bp.product_level = 'A赏' THEN 10 WHEN bp.product_level = 'B赏' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_points, COUNT(CASE WHEN bp.product_level = 'A赏' THEN 1 END) AS a_count, COUNT(CASE WHEN bp.product_level = 'B赏' THEN 1 END) AS b_count FROM shop_user u JOIN box_product bp ON u.user_id = bp.user_id WHERE bp.product_level IN ('A赏', 'B赏') AND bp.activity_type IN ('一番赏', '踩雷赏') AND YEAR(bp.obtain_time) = YEAR(CURRENT_DATE) AND MONTH(bp.obtain_time) = MONTH(CURRENT_DATE) GROUP BY u.user_id, u.user_name, u.avatar ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 10
